locales.title: Kana Sprint
locales.subtitle: 日语假名与台词速记游戏
locales.promoText: 60 秒短局练日语：假名、JLPT N5-N1 词汇、原创动漫感台词，连击刷分。
locales.description: Kana Sprint 是一款轻量、可反复玩的日语学习游戏。你需要在 60 秒内快速匹配平假名、片假名、JLPT N5-N1 分级词汇和原创动漫感台词。连续答对会提升连击得分，答错会扣生命，并进入本机薄弱项复习。今日挑战会固定题序，并记录每日连续学习天数，方便每天回来刷新纪录。内容适合从假名到高阶词汇的日语学习者，也适合想用碎片时间复习常用表达的玩家。

locales.title: Kana Sprint
locales.subtitle: Japanese kana speed game
locales.promoText: Train kana, JLPT N5-N1 words, and original anime-style Japanese lines in quick 60-second runs.
locales.description: Kana Sprint is a fast, replayable Japanese learning game. Match hiragana, katakana, romaji, JLPT N5-N1 vocabulary, and original anime-style Japanese lines before the 60-second timer runs out. Correct answers build combo score, mistakes cost lives and feed a local weak-item review loop, and the daily challenge uses a fixed question order plus a local streak counter so you have a reason to come back every day.
